coaching.headline: Nine won fights, nine cashed — a perfect conversion game, majors 25-7, every Fangtooth, Genesis, Orb and Primal on our side of the ledger.
coaching.team: This is what the film program wants every week: 9-for-9 turning fights into Fangtooth (7, 13, 18), Genesis (22), Orb and Primal (25), while they cashed zero. The paper reads said carry and jungle were behind; the scoreboard (Murdock 11/0, Kallari 12/2) overruled the paper — worth saying both. The sloppiness a better team punishes: three deaths caught alone outside any fight (Renna 2.6, Shinbi 9 and 18 — the 18-minute one preceded a tower); a stronger enemy makes those cost.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 13-minute 5-0 wipe at our Fangtooth — five of them into three of us and they lost every body — then every subsequent fight cashed on schedule.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock, 11/0/12 with 28.4k objective damage into a lane that read theirs on paper — the film's answer to the read. Nothing to fix on the line itself; the deathless carry is why 9-for-9 was possible.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Phase went 2/0/23 with 15 wards — every fight had the lifeline attached. The build note stands for next time: Galaxy Greaves was the missing core piece.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Kallari 12/2 with 23.9k objective damage — the fights were won at the arrival angles Kallari created, and the objective damage cashed them. The one habit: 1 ward all game. On a 27-minute stomp it never mattered; against an even team it does.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi's 4 deaths were the only red line on our board — two of them caught alone (9 and 18 minutes, the second preceding a tower). The lane flipped from theirs early to ours late, so the trade was fine; the solo deaths are the cut.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna went 5/2/8 with an on-core build (Entropy, Wraith Leggings) — the 2.6-minute catch by Khaimera was the only early wobble, and the Magnify spike at ~24 lined up with the fight streak that closed it.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 3 items of it.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Shadow Walk stealth → Crippling Dagger slow → Shadow Dance gap-close → Guillotine execute ult
ourKits.winCondition: stealth-pick an isolated squishy and execute with Guillotine
ourKits.passive: Death Mark detonates for bonus burst
ourKits.playWith: a team that follows her pick
ourKits.playAgainst: ward/reveal for the stealth; she's the squishiest hero — any CC kills her

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
enemyKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
enemyKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

enemyKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
enemyKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
enemyKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

enemyKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
enemyKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
enemyKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

murdock.loadout: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point), augment Justice's Reach, crest Pacifier
lines: Lead story: Hard to kill. Never died in 27 minutes, fewer deaths than about 98% of Murdock carry players this patch. The build added healing off damage.
Murdock dealt 38,695 hero damage, 35% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against GRIM.exe (level 13: about 89 physical armor, 77 after penetration; took 12,170 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) and Khaimera (level 14: about 78 physical armor, 66 after penetration; took 9,498 physical damage from heroes, 53% of all hero damage they took) that is about 7% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 1,878 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Tainted Rounds, Vermis.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Tainted Rounds, Pacifier.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Murdock killed built physical armor (Sevarog). Anti-heal on GRIM.exe, Sevarog, Narbash. We killed Murdock 0 times.

Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 46.6% in 1,785 Murdock carry games, below the hero's 48.6%; this 3-item core: 62.4% in 157 games, above the 53.7% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.

kallari.loadout: Lotus (Masterpiece + Prima Donna), augment Critical Override, crest Ortus

sources.note: random: 28 procs, 1 in 4 is +4 haste (expected value)
sources.how: 28 random bonuses (every 2 min and every takedown), 1 in 4 is +4 haste: about +28 expected

fedBy: Malady (Demise): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage.• Gain a stack of Demise.• Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise.• Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Ortus (Limit Breaker): Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s.• Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
ultPlus: Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 863 hero damage a minute, more than 79% of Kallari jungle players this patch (21% of the team's). The damage came from Malady, Imperator, Necrosis.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Kallari touched shortened Guillotine, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 76.4s late); fight right after Guillotine is spent.
Guillotine at rank 2: 110s base, about 76.4s by the end (31% shorter) from 44 ability haste: Malady 8, Ortus 8, Lotus 28.
15 takedowns (12 kills, 3 assists) fed: Malady (Demise), Ortus (Limit Breaker), Lotus (Eternal).
Necrosis (Necro's Edge): Gain 25 Ultimate Haste.
Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Kallari dealt 23,308 hero damage, 21% of their team's, with +217 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11, Vanquisher 12, Ortus 5; against Eden (level 14: about 92 physical armor, 64 after penetration; took 16,432 physical damage from heroes, 58% of all hero damage they took) and GRIM.exe (level 13: about 89 physical armor, 61 after penetration; took 12,170 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) that is about 17% and 17% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Malady (item): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage. Gain a stack of Demise. Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise. Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Necrosis (item): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Masterpiece (Eternal minor): Kills grant 4% Bonus Damage and 5% Movement Speed for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.
Prima Donna (Eternal minor): Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.
Critical Override (augment): Kallari's Abilities can Critically Strike, but her Critical Damage is decreased by 35%.
Lesson: Kallari's penetration cut through: Eden took about 17% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 14 their armor was about 92, about 64 after 28 flat penetration).
Stack (Every takedown fed): 3 effects on one trigger: Malady, Ortus, Lotus. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Vanquisher. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
The Eternal was part of it: Lotus (Masterpiece + Prima Donna) sits on the same trigger as the items (every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Kallari killed built physical armor (Sevarog). We killed Kallari 2 times.

Copy it? Lotus (Masterpiece + Prima Donna): 51.3% in 191 Kallari jungle games, above the hero's 47.2%; this 3-item core: 51.8% in 83 games, level with the 51.7% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Kallari's takedowns fed Guillotine: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Guillotine is used.
